instruction: Cinematic medium close-up in an indoor sports gym. Three cheerleaders pose close together. On the left, the brunette cheerleader (R9) looks to the right with a smirk. In the center, the blonde cheerleader with her hair in a high bun (R2) tilts her head far right, looking forward. On the right, the red-haired cheerleader (R3) smiles broadly, looking forward. Soft indoor lighting illuminates their faces against a blurred background of colorful bleachers.
